old: Her old knees felt young again
new: Her old knees became young again
reason: Butler: "Her aged knees became young again"; "felt" turns his statement of rejuvenation into a subjective impression.

old: for you have always been such a reasonable person
new: for you always used to be a reasonable person
reason: Butler: "for you always used to be a reasonable person"; the past-habitual is what makes the argument work (she was sensible, so the gods have now unhinged her), and "such" is an added intensifier.
